text: What traffic shift made three-tier data centre designs unsuitable?
choices: North-south to east-west: one user request now triggers dozens of internal service calls, so server-to-server traffic dwarfs traffic to users
explanation: Two servers in adjacent racks had to traverse access, distribution and core — three hops up and three down — while spanning tree blocked half the available links. The topology was optimised for a pattern that no longer existed.
